meta.selection: Successful canonical prematch; latest contamination audit; prediction before saved start, schedule fallback
meta.market: First valid pre_prediction snapshot per book; proportional no-vig; equal book weights
meta.bets: source=model; won/lost only; manual verdict precedence; independently settled from series score
meta.disagreement: Strictly opposite favorites around 0.5; exact ties counted separately; same forecasts for model and market Brier
meta.dependence: Forecasts and bets repeat the same series; n is not a count of independent outcomes
meta.exploration: Champion and exclusions chosen retrospectively; mixture weights are a fixed grid, not an optimized strategy
